title: Geographic Demand Surge
scenario: Find cities that experienced a 'Demand Surge' (views > 150% of the 30-day moving average) for more than 3 non-consecutive days in a month.
hint: Use RANGE frames for moving averages.
correctQuery: WITH DailyDemand AS (SELECT city_id, request_date, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2), MovingAvg AS (SELECT city_id, request_date, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER(PARTITION BY city_id ORDER BY request_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND INTERVAL '1 day' PRECEDING) as avg_30 FROM DailyDemand) SELECT city_id FROM MovingAvg WHERE cnt > 1.5 * avg_30 GROUP BY city_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE trips (city_id INT, request_date DATE);
